### Foundational Survey Papers

* **[Multi-agent Collaboration Mechanisms: A Survey of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.06322)**
  * **Authors:** K. T. Tran, D. Dao, M. D. Nguyen, Q. V. Pham, et al.
  * **Focus:** Coordination protocols, communication topologies, and collaborative task allocation.
* **[A Survey on LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems: Workflow, Infrastructure, and Challenges](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s44336-024-00009-2)**
  * **Authors:** X. Li, S. Wang, S. Zeng, Y. Wu, Y. Yang (*Springer*)
  * **Focus:** Infrastructure, orchestrator designs, tool integration, and environment feedback loops.
* **[LLM-Based Multi-Agent Orchestration: A Survey of Frameworks, Communication Protocols, and Emerging Patterns](https://www.preprints.org/manuscript/202604.2147)**
  * **Authors:** Y. Zhu, L. Liu, J. Yu, D. Zhang
  * **Focus:** Centralized vs. decentralized routing, communication protocols, and architectural patterns.
* **[LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems: Frameworks, Evaluation, Open Challenges, and Research Frontiers](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-032-15632-7_9)**
  * **Authors:** S. H. Shaikh (*Springer*)
  * **Focus:** Comparative framework evaluations, pipeline reliability, and prompt interfaces.
* **[A Survey on Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent Systems: Paradigms, Applications, and Challenges](https://www.techrxiv.org/doi/pdf/10.36227/techrxiv.177160638.89229642)**
  * **Authors:** M. Zhu et al.
  * **Focus:** Static orchestration pipelines vs. dynamic negotiation frameworks.
* **[Large Language Models in the Loop: A Stability- and Network-Aware Survey in Networked Control, Cyber-Physical, and Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16599)**
  * **Authors:** H. Du, L. Chan
  * **Focus:** Network topologies, communication delay bounds, and control-theoretic stability.

---

### Empirical Frameworks & Benchmarks (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML)

* **[Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.19591)** (NeurIPS)
  * **Framework:** Centralized RL puppeteer dynamically orchestrating specialized LLM agents. Open-source implementation available via [ChatDev/puppeteer](https://github.com/OpenBMB/ChatDev/tree/puppeteer).
* **[Graph-of-Agents: A Graph-based Framework for Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17148)** (ICLR)
  * **Framework:** GoA; uses node sampling, dynamic directed relevance edges, and bidirectional message passing. Outperformed Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) on MMLU-Pro, GPQA, and MATH.
* **[A Two-Tier Perspective on Inference-Time Parallelism in Multi-Agent LLM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05791)** (ICML)
  * **Framework:** TIPEX; splits inference into Replica Parallelism and Structural Parallelism. Benchmarked on GAIA.
* **[SquidAgent: Parallelize Wisely, Coordinate Efficiently](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08647)** (NeurIPS)
  * **Framework:** Adaptive parallel scheduler resolving multi-agent task dependencies to reduce coordination latency overhead.
* **[CEO Arena: Evaluating Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Decision-Making in Competitive Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34821)** (ICLR)
  * **Benchmark:** Empirical evaluation suite for multi-agent competitive orchestration over long horizons.

---

### Findings Comparison

* **Coverage:** Agent 1 gathered broad surveys, taxonomy papers, and control-theoretic angles. Agent 2 gathered peer-reviewed empirical architectures, scheduling methods, and evaluation benchmarks.
* **Consistency:** Both agents agree on the primary technical challenges: dynamic task allocation, communication topology bottlenecks, and coordination overhead. No contradictory claims were found.

  * **Authors:** Y. Zhu, L. Liu, J. Yu, D. Zhang
  * **Citations:** 9
  * **Focus:** Focuses specifically on orchestration paradigms, interaction topologies (centralized vs. decentralized routing), agent communication protocols, and architectural design patterns.

  * **Citations:** 19
  * **Focus:** Comparative evaluation of foundational frameworks supporting multi-agent workflow orchestration, profiling pipeline reliability, prompt interfaces, and multi-agent coordination.

* **[A Survey on Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent Systems: Paradigms, Applications, and Challenges](https://www.techrxiv.org/doi/pdf/10.36227/techrxiv.177160638.89229642)**
  * **Authors:** M. Zhu, M. Li, M. Cui, Z. Qian, Y. Jiang, M. Han, M. Sun
  * **Focus:** Architectural paradigms distinguishing predefined static orchestration pipelines from dynamic autonomous multi-agent negotiation frameworks.

* **[Large Language Models in the Loop: A Stability- and Network-Aware Survey in Networked Control, Cyber-Physical, and Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16599)**
  * **Authors:** H. Du, L. Chan
  * **Focus:** Multi-agent network topologies, communication delay bounds, and control-theoretic stability in agentic orchestration workflows.
### Task: Search recent AI conference publications (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML) for empirical research papers and benchmarks on multi-agent orchestration frameworks.
- Status: COMPLETED (Worker: worker_find_framework_papers_4ebe7898, Tab: tab_find_framework_papers_123f6c)
- Findings: Empirical research papers and benchmarks on multi-agent orchestration frameworks accepted to NeurIPS, ICLR, and ICML:

#### 1. Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Orchestration
- **Venue:** NeurIPS
- **Paper Link:** [arXiv:2505.19591](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.19591)
- **Framework / Core Method:** Puppeteer-style centralized orchestration framework where an RL-trained orchestrator dynamically sequences, prioritizes, and coordinates specialized LLM agents ("puppets") instead of maintaining static multi-agent graphs.
- **Empirical Findings & Benchmarks:** Evaluated across closed- and open-domain multi-step reasoning benchmarks. Demonstrated superior accuracy while cutting computational overhead, driven by the emergence of compact, cyclic coordination structures. Code released on GitHub ([ChatDev/puppeteer](https://github.com/OpenBMB/ChatDev/tree/puppeteer)).

#### 2. Graph-of-Agents: A Graph-based Framework for Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
- **Venue:** ICLR
- **Paper Link:** [arXiv:2604.17148](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17148)
- **Framework / Core Method:** **GoA** (Graph-of-Agents), an orchestration architecture utilizing node sampling via LLM model cards, dynamic directed relevance graph edges, bidirectional message passing, and graph-based response pooling.
- **Empirical Findings & Benchmarks:** Benchmarked on general and domain benchmarks including **MMLU, MMLU-Pro, GPQA, MATH, HumanEval, and MedMCQA**. Evaluated with an agent pool of 6 models; GoA achieved top accuracy using only 3 dynamically orchestrated agents, outperforming Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) baselines that invoked all 6 agents.

#### 3. A Two-Tier Perspective on Inference-Time Parallelism in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
- **Venue:** ICML
- **Paper Link:** [arXiv:2608.05791](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05791)
- **Framework / Core Method:** **TIPEX**, an execution orchestration framework classifying inference parallelism into Replica Parallelism (multi-path task exploration) and Structural Parallelism (concurrent subtask decomposition).
- **Empirical Findings & Benchmarks:** Benchmarked rigorously on the **GAIA** agent benchmark. Demonstrated that structured parallel coordination substantially boosts accuracy and decreases latency over sequential orchestration, with intermediate-complexity tasks gaining the highest net improvement.

#### 4. SquidAgent: Parallelize Wisely, Coordinate Efficiently
- **Venue:** NeurIPS
- **Paper Link:** [arXiv:2610.08647](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08647)
- **Framework / Core Method:** Adaptive multi-agent parallel scheduler designed to balance intra-agent task dependencies with near-linear parallel execution speedups.
- **Empirical Findings & Benchmarks:** Analyzed execution bottlenecks in multi-agent orchestration, reporting empirical tradeoffs between coordination overhead and task completion speed across complex multi-step tasks.

#### 5. CEO Arena: Evaluating Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Decision-Making in Competitive Markets
- **Venue:** ICLR
- **Paper Link:** [arXiv:2609.34821](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34821)
- **Framework / Core Method:** **CEO Arena**, a dedicated benchmark evaluating multi-agent orchestration and competitive coordination over long planning horizons under dynamic market uncertainty.
- **Empirical Findings & Benchmarks:** 46-page empirical study evaluating leading open and proprietary LLM agent frameworks on long-horizon business and resource orchestration decisions.
